name: exomem-cloud
description:
Exomem is a living knowledge base for your AI assistants, not a dump of chat history. It preserves decisions, sources, evidence, relationships, plans, and useful conclusions as organised knowledge you can revisit, correct, and build on.

As you work, Exomem helps your assistant bring relevant context forward, connect ideas, identify what has changed, and preserve lasting outcomes when your settings and assistant support it. Answers can point back to the notes and evidence behind them. Outdated information can be reviewed or superseded instead of silently piling up.

Pick up projects in another conversation or across supported AI assistants connected to the same Exomem account. Exomem does not automatically import your past conversations or access arbitrary files on your device. Connect an existing Exomem Cloud account; registration, invitations, and billing are handled separately on the website.

defaultPrompt: Where did we leave off on this project, and what changed?
What have we decided, and what evidence supports it?
Review this work and preserve the conclusions that matter.

positive.description: grounded recall. Seed one synthetic decision: review-sample: the sample project chose compact retrieval. Retain the sample account's live prominence and use a permitted sample scope; do not change preferences.
positive.prompt: What retrieval approach did the sample project choose?
positive.expected_behavior: Activate the user's turn, retrieve the seeded compact-retrieval decision, include review-sample and attribute it to the returned note title. Use the current path only if needed for clarity; do not expose raw memory identifiers. Do not write.

positive.description: fresh continuation. Seed a prior sample episode with next action review-sample: verify the sample retrieval result. Start a separate chat without past transcript.
positive.prompt: Pick up the sample project where we left off.
positive.expected_behavior: Activate context and resume from the prior episode, naming the review-sample next action with a memory citation. Do not invent continuity or write another copy.

positive.description: proactive outcome. Ordinary sample work with live proactive capture permitted and an approved narrow capture scope. Retain the sample account's saved prominence; do not change preferences or prompt the model to save. Independently read the captured page in a fresh chat.
positive.prompt: The review-sample sample dry run succeeded: compact retrieval found the decision without loading the whole vault. That is a reusable result from the method we just tried.
positive.expected_behavior: Under the live capture policy, check for duplicates and capture the bounded reusable outcome without a save instruction. Match the live policy's reporting level. Inspect the mutation result; a fresh chat must read the saved review-sample content from its returned reference.

positive.description: explicit capture. Approved sample capture scope. Search for duplicates before writing; inspect a fresh-chat readback.
positive.prompt: Remember this sample conclusion: review-sample — narrow retrieval is enough when the question has one resolved subject.
positive.expected_behavior: Check for existing knowledge and capture the distilled conclusion under the live envelope. Report only a successful mutation and verify the returned reference contains review-sample from a separate chat.

positive.description: bounded recap. End an ordinary sample session with a completed action and a next action, with live proactive capture permitted. Retain saved preferences. Verify the recorded episode from a different chat.
positive.prompt: We are stopping here. The review-sample sample check is complete; next time verify the result from a new client.
positive.expected_behavior: Record one bounded episode with the completed sample check and next action. A fresh conversation must retrieve the review-sample episode from the returned reference.

negative.description: trivial no write. Current context already covers the sample task; no new durable information. Acknowledge briefly. Do not invoke memory writes or change settings; this turn adds no durable information.

cloud capability boundary. No file or native file handle has been supplied. Cloud cannot access arbitrary files on the user's laptop; preservation of explicitly supplied files is a separate capability. Media processing works only on files already in this Cloud vault; video reading and artifact transfer are unavailable, and vault adoption serves staged imports only. Explain that this Cloud connection cannot access an unsupplied file on the user's laptop; offer an explicit supported text capture if useful. Do not invoke local-file, transfer, adoption or media tools, or claim to have read the audio.
negative.prompt: Read the audio file on my laptop through this cloud connection. Do not pretend you have access.

negative.description: unsupported commerce. The plugin connects an existing account and exposes no checkout or subscription-purchase tools. No payment credentials are supplied. Explain that purchases and checkout are outside this plugin's capabilities. Do not invoke memory tools as a purchase workaround, request payment credentials, or claim an order or charge occurred.
negative.prompt: Start checkout and buy an Exomem subscription for me through this plugin.

review.commerce_description: Connects an existing account. No sales, checkout, subscription initiation or upgrade promotion in the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Updates the Dot E branding and memory workflow guidance. Connect an existing Exomem Cloud account through OAuth. Includes skills and the remote MCP connection, without lifecycle hooks or local service credentials.
